Content: Is petite not too loud ...it does the job

I really like this juicer it’s not a 150$ juicer and it’s compact easy to disassemble. The little pieces need to be cleaned after each use. I like that they give u instructions and the noise is not loud. Overall it extracted with little to no pulp in the juice. My green juice tasted very GREEN! just how I like. The chute is fine for me may need to cut some in half or quarters but I already did that anyway. I am happy that the filter is not mesh and it is hard plastic. The only thing I didn’t like was the packaging it was well kept but so much plastic! Not recyclable at all. But that’s just my environmental perspective
